author: deustp01
body: Reactome (29 instances) done, with the usual regrets about the loss of information and duplication of curator effort caused by defects in the ChEBI "ontology". Note: I didn't work through the list above but instead queried our internal database to find all uses of each deprecated GO term - less time consuming and probably more reliable.
